papers.what_it_is: A theory paper reducing a fixed window of projected-gradient adversarial (robust) training, via a polynomial surrogate and a truncated discrete-time Carleman lift, to one sparse block-bidiagonal linear system solved by a quantum linear-system algorithm, with proofs of the conditioning, truncation, transfer and readout bounds.
